name: Junket Ice Cream with Peaches
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)
steps: Mix first four ingredients, and add junket tablets dissolved in cold water.
Turn into a pudding-dish and let stand until set.
Freeze, mould, and serve garnished with halves of peaches, filling cavities with halves of blanched almonds.
Turn peaches into a saucepan, add one-third cup sugar, and cook slowly until syrup is thick.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
